items.label: MaxLinear press release: MaxLinear Expands AI Infrastructure Control-Plane Portfolio (08-10-2026)
items.signal_prefix: MaxLinear launched two 16V high-current eFuse devices for AI infrastructure powe

set.signal: MaxLinear launched two 16V high-current eFuse devices for AI infrastructure power protection and telemetry (AI servers, accelerator trays, data center switches, fan trays, power shelves, plug-in modules): the MxL745950 (16V, 50A, 1mOhm on-resistance, 5mm x 5mm LGA-32) and the stackable MxL745951P (16V, 60A, 0.79mOhm on-resistance, PMBus/I2C telemetry with +/-1% current monitoring accuracy, 5mm x 4.5mm VQFN-26L). Both are sampling now with volume production expected in Q4 2026.

items.reason: The $1.0B eFuse market size is a third-party industry estimate, not a company figure (skill 2: no third-party figures); drop that sentence, keep the product facts.
items.evidence: Industry estimates place the global eFuse market at approximately $1.0B today, with growth expected through 2030
